title: CRM pane on a ticket shows only a fixed set of fields

rows.b: 1. Fields shown in the Info tab
rows.zoho: All CRM fields of the record, custom fields included (Lead Source, Created/Modified By, Locked, Record Id…)
rows.tavi: 8 fixed fields (name, email, phone, mobile, title, account, owner)
Stored in config (panel.info_fields) but no screen to change it

notes: NDC-1669 §7 (P0, Phase 3) asks for the CRM profile in the ticket; the field set is not specified.
